title: Quechua Men's SH100 U-Warm Waterproof Snow Boots
body_html:
Description

The Decathlon Quechua SH100 U-Warm Men's Full-Zip High Snow Boot, Waterproof is designed for cold and snowy weather conditions. They are made with a waterproof and breathable membrane that keeps your feet dry and comfortable, while the insulation ensures warmth even in temperatures as low as -8°F. The boots also feature a high-top design that provides additional protection and support for your ankles. The outsole of the SH100 U-Warm Waterproof High Snow Boots is made of rubber, which provides excellent traction on snowy and slippery surfaces. The upper is made of synthetic materials that are durable and easy to clean. The boots have a zip-up closure system that allows you to easily put them on and remove them. The location and depth of the 3.5 mm studs provide traction on snow with Snowcontact technology grip: materials and tread pattern of the soles.

Highlights:

  • Comfort temperature when stationary: 9°F. On the move -8°F. We chose a warm lining that has insulation to give you effective protection from the cold.
  • Grip with Snowcontact technology: materials and tread pattern of the soles. Optimizes propulsion, prevents the boot from slipping backward when going uphill, and stabilizes the boot.
  • Waterproof and breathable membrane for keeping your feet dry.
  • Waterproofness test, we test 3 levels of waterproofness: 2000 flexes (about 2.5-mile walk), 4000 flexes (about 5-mile walk), and 8000 flexes (about 10-mile walk). Your boots were tested to 4,000 flexes, which is equivalent to 5 miles of walking.
  • TractionThe location and depth of the 3.5 mm studs provide traction on snow. Prevents the boot from slipping and skidding on the smooth ground or in demanding conditions (rain, snow, ice) by giving the sole grip.
